timeline.summary: AGI Greenpac completed its second tranche investment of ₹1.43 Cr in Madoverbuilding AI, bringing its total stake to 19.75% for ₹4.43 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹742.39 Cr (+5.3% YoY), net profit ₹115.38 Cr (+19.4% YoY).
Commenced construction of ₹1,000 Cr greenfield aluminium beverage can plant in Hathras, UP with 1.6B can launch capacity.
Sandip Somany, Sumita Somany, Shashvat Somany, and 15 other promoter entities declared no share encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026, signed April 3, 2026.
AGI Greenpac shareholders approved all 5 postal ballot resolutions including CMD Sandip Somany's re-appointment despite significant public institutional dissent.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹655.46 Cr (+9.0% YoY), net profit ₹66.5 Cr (-12.5% YoY).
AGI Greenpac released its Q2FY27 investor presentation, confirming glass capacity expansion to 2,600 TPD by March 2027 and entry into aluminium cans.

upcoming_events.description: Targeted commissioning of Hathras aluminium can plant in H1 2027
